nodes.name: Claim Item Instagram

parameters.query:
with context as (
  select
    '{{ $json.profile }}'::text as profile,
    '{{ $json.marketplace }}'::text as marketplace,
    nullif('{{ $json.instagram_format || "" }}', '')::text as instagram_format,
    {{ $json.dry_run ? 'true' : 'false' }}::boolean as dry_run,
    '{{ $json.target || "oferta.femininas" }}'::text as target,
    '{{ $json.run_id || "instagram-manual" }}'::text as run_id,
    nullif('{{ $json.instagram_business_account_id || "" }}', '')::text as instagram_business_account_id,
    nullif('{{ $json.whatsapp_group_url || "" }}', '')::text as whatsapp_group_url
), candidate as (
  select plan.dispatch_plan_id
  from context ctx
  join offers.daily_dispatch_plan plan on true
  join offers.v_instagram_dispatch_ready ready
    on ready.dispatch_plan_id = plan.dispatch_plan_id
  where ready.profile = ctx.profile
    and ready.marketplace = ctx.marketplace
    and ready.planned_date <= (now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
    and (ctx.instagram_format is null or ready.instagram_format = ctx.instagram_format)
  order by ready.planned_date, ready.daily_sequence, ready.instagram_format desc
  limit 1
  for update of plan skip locked
), claimed as (
  update offers.daily_dispatch_plan plan
  set dispatch_status = 'claimed',
      claim_token = (select run_id from context),
      claimed_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
  from candidate
  where plan.dispatch_plan_id = candidate.dispatch_plan_id
    and not (select dry_run from context)
  returning plan.dispatch_plan_id
), selected as (
  select candidate.dispatch_plan_id
  from candidate
  cross join context
  where context.dry_run
  union all
  select claimed.dispatch_plan_id
  from claimed
)
select
  ready.*,
  ctx.dry_run,
  ctx.target,
  ctx.run_id,
  ctx.instagram_business_account_id,
  ctx.whatsapp_group_url,
  case when ctx.dry_run then 'cancelled' else 'confirmed' end as delivery_status
from selected
join offers.v_instagram_dispatch_ready ready using (dispatch_plan_id)
cross join context ctx
limit 1;

nodes.notes: Claim atomico do item pronto; a selecao vem de offers.v_instagram_dispatch_ready e o lock acontece na tabela real.

parameters.query:
update offers.offer_media_assets
set status = 'stale',
    last_checked_at = now(),
    error_detail = 'media_revalidation_failed'
where profile = '{{ $json.profile }}'
  and marketplace = '{{ $json.marketplace }}'
  and item_id = {{ $json.item_id }};

insert into offers.publication_events (
  dispatch_plan_id, profile, marketplace, stable_key, item_id,
  target, channel_adapter, delivery_status, manifest_item_number,
  artifact_generated_at, manifest_created_at, planned_at, sent_at,
  offer_title, offer_url, offer_price, message_text, payload
)
values (
  case when {{ $json.dry_run ? 'true' : 'false' }} then null else '{{ $json.dispatch_plan_id }}'::uuid end,
  '{{ $json.profile }}',
  '{{ $json.marketplace }}',
  '{{ $json.stable_key }}',
  {{ $json.item_id }},
  '{{ $json.target || "oferta.femininas" }}',
  case when '{{ $json.instagram_format }}' = 'reels' then 'instagram_reels' else 'instagram_carousel' end,
  '{{ $json.delivery_status || "cancelled" }}',
  coalesce({{ $json.daily_sequence }}, 1),
  now(),
  now(),
  '{{ $json.planned_at }}'::timestamptz,
  case when '{{ $json.delivery_status }}' = 'confirmed' then now() else null end,
  '{{ $json.product_name }}',
  '{{ $json.offer_link }}',
  {{ $json.price || 'null' }},
  '{{ $json.caption_base }}',
  jsonb_build_object(
    'run_id', '{{ $json.run_id }}',
    'dry_run', {{ $json.dry_run ? 'true' : 'false' }},
    'source_dispatch_plan_id', '{{ $json.dispatch_plan_id }}',
    'instagram_format', '{{ $json.instagram_format }}',
    'media_validation', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.media_validation || []) }}'::jsonb,
    'blocked_reason', '{{ $json.blocked_reason || "" }}',
    'container_status', '{{ $json.container_status || "" }}',
    'container_id', '{{ $json.creation_id || "" }}'
  )
)
on conflict (dispatch_plan_id) where dispatch_plan_id is not null
do update
set delivery_status = excluded.delivery_status,
    sent_at = excluded.sent_at,
    message_text = excluded.message_text,
    payload = excluded.payload,
    updated_at = now()
returning publish_id;
